tasks.title: Freeze portable RestClient contracts and shared execution seams
tasks.validation: A01-A03/A05/A22: ordinary public signatures and exact5 result properties, valid DTO/default/null/absent/failure construction, invalid combination rejection, immutable copied context/options, explicit callback/retry disable and finite16client/32pair metadata. Compile actual Core+tests; verify ordinary API exposes no HTTP/Polly/OTel types. Review shared ownership, entry-based clock, policy terminal summary and single observation binding before freeze; no fabricated transport/adapter pass.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Implement the approved portable9-method IRestClient surface, guarded immutable five-property RestResult and typed detached context, explicit value-presence/null/empty/truncation semantics, isolated client/call defaults and body/header/query/retry/extension contracts. Fix P04 fault-versus-known-cancellation precedence and W3C correlation mapping. Freeze minimal internal attempt/body-reader/retry/observation/passive-composition seams so transport, extensions, optional retry and collector can compile independently. Preserve native/SDK-free ordinary signatures, exact Core closure and no frameworks or stage graph. Include portable vectors, meaningful contract/architecture tests, docs and independent review.
